body: walker.file calls nested only after mayBeArchive(head) on the same first bytes isArchiveContent re-reads, so isArchiveContent(b) is always true there and the 'return false, nil' branch could never run. Deleted (behaviour unchanged) under the coverage task tsk_01a11a7aab78774790ef65ebe50b3db7; the doc comment now states the invariant.
title: archive: removed the unreachable 'not archive content' branch in walker.nested
